author: Kruggsmash
description:
*An edited, illustrated and narrated playthrough of the game Dwarf Fortress*

Today, we're having a look at that oh-so-forgettable material that lies within us all- Bone! What will happen when dwarves fight wars with bone? When they trade with bone? Structure their lives around bone? Well, we'll find out soon- no bones about it!

Also, prehistoric update for DF too haha.

Music by Ivan Duch: https://ivanduch.com/

Intro & End tunes by Topher Anselmo: https://topheranselmo.com/

title: Short Forts: The Power of Bone
